column1: # Japanese (ja) catalog. Same format as zh-hant.tsv:  context <TAB> source <TAB> translation
# (empty context = a plain UI string; `@id` = a command id; `@plural` = "one|other" forms).
# Clean-room: menu and feature names follow the names Japanese users of vector illustration
# software know, written from the meaning of VectorCraft's English labels; no other application's
# Japanese localisation was copied. Toggles read as their action (「…を表示」「…を隠す」).
# Coverage: every menu label (tested: `menu_catalogs_translate_every_menu_label`); panels and
# dialogs fall back to English. Left in English on purpose (`MENU_KEEP_AS_IS` in the tests): the
# product name, language names, OpenType, the built-in workspace names and the bracketed perspective
# grid preset names. Set `complete_menus` in i18n/mod.rs once every `tl!` literal has a row too.
